title: MGE-PO: Entropy-Aware Credit Assignment for Mathematical Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.23245v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: GRPO assigns the same group-relative advantage to equally rewarded responses within a question, leaving their generation uncertainty unused. We introduce MGE-PO, centered on four-quadrant (4Q) advantage shaping that combines verified correctness with rollout generation entropy. Correctness determines the sign of an additional correction, while entropy controls its magnitude: lower-entropy successes receive larger bonuses and higher-entropy failures receive larger penalties. An online entropy-based question curriculum supports this credit rule using cached rollout measurements. At the final checkpoint after eight training epochs on Qwen3-8B-Base, adding 4Q across three policy optimization settings yields absolute gains of 3.23-3.69% in six-benchmark macro avg@32 and 4.24-11.06% in macro pass@32. On Qwen2.5-7B-Base, the complete configuration raises four-benchmark macro avg@32 from 41.5% to 45.4%.

translated_title: MGE-PO：面向数学推理的熵感知信用分配方法
translated_abstract: GRPO对同一问题内获得相同奖励的回复赋予相同的组相对优势，从而忽略了这些回复的生成不确定性。我们提出MGE-PO，其核心是四象限（4Q）优势塑形方法，将经验证的答案正确性与rollout生成熵相结合。正确性决定额外校正项的符号，而熵控制其幅度：低熵的成功样本获得更大的奖励，高熵的失败样本受到更大的惩罚。一个基于熵的在线问题课程机制利用缓存的rollout测量结果来支持这一信用分配规则。在Qwen3-8B-Base上经过八个训练周期后的最终检查点处，在三种策略优化设置中加入4Q，在六个基准测试的macro avg@32上带来了3.23-3.69%的绝对提升，在macro pass@32上带来了4.24-11.06%的绝对提升。在Qwen2.5-7B-Base上，完整配置将四个基准测试的macro avg@32从41.5%提升至45.4%。
tldr: MGE-PO提出了一种结合验证正确性与生成熵的四象限优势塑形方法，通过对低熵成功给予更大奖励、高熵失败给予更大惩罚来改进GRPO的信用分配机制，显著提升了数学推理性能。
en_tdlr: MGE-PO introduces a four-quadrant advantage shaping that combines verified correctness with generation entropy—rewarding low-entropy successes and penalizing high-entropy failures more heavily—to improve GRPO's credit assignment and significantly boost mathematical reasoning performance.
